material_findings.credential_boundary: Agentic Wallet requires a dedicated API key; OAuth tokens are rejected on wallet routes. wallet:read reads policy/balances/reservations; wallet:spend requests policy-controlled x402 payments or direct transfers.
material_findings.policy_boundary: One agent identity is bound to one dedicated key and one immutable policy version. Policies control networks, per-transaction/daily/monthly USDC limits, approval thresholds, expiry, pause/revoke state, optional x402 domains and optional direct-transfer recipient restrictions.
material_findings.x402_request_binding: x402/fetch accepts agentId, network, URL, HTTP method and maxValue. Domain restrictions can narrow destinations. This improves request binding evidence but does not document exact payTo binding or prove that a malicious/mismatched 402 response cannot redirect settlement.
material_findings.transfer_surface: A generic direct-USDC transfer endpoint exists under wallet:spend but requires permissions.transfer=true. James configuration MUST set permissions.transfer=false and machine-negative-test the transfer endpoint.
material_findings.replay_and_indeterminate: Stable Idempotency-Key is supported. Reusing the same key with a different body returns idempotency_key_reused; in-progress identical actions return idempotency_request_in_progress. Individual authorizations expire after ten minutes and indeterminate provider submissions remain submitting to prevent duplicate payment.
material_findings.signer_isolation: For Base, the owner authorizes a Thirdweb User Wallet by email OTP for the grant. ELTEX states it encrypts the session and never exposes it to the agent. This remains a vendor assertion until negative tests show the James credential has no key/session export or generic-sign capability.
material_findings.network_asset: Documentation describes USDC authority and Base/Solana policy controls. James must configure Base only and machine-negative-test Solana/other-network and non-USDC attempts.
material_findings.failure_semantics: agent_wallet_policy_denied is documented as a stop condition when the active policy does not authorize a request; spending_authorization_required is also a stop condition. Budget/policy-state outage or unreadable-state fail-closed behavior remains machine-test-only.
material_findings.audit: Every /v1 response includes X-Request-ID; wallet surfaces expose policy, balances/reservations and preflight. Sufficiency for C12 still requires captured zero-balance machine evidence.

zero_balance_setup_requirements.per_transaction_cap: <= A$25 equivalent with conservative FX buffer
zero_balance_setup_requirements.daily_cap: <= A$40 equivalent with conservative FX buffer
zero_balance_setup_requirements.agent_credential: dedicated wallet-scoped credential only; never record credential value in repo/model/shared logs
zero_balance_setup_requirements.founder_authorization: email OTP only outside model-visible surfaces if/when setup is approved; no private key or seed phrase
zero_balance_setup_requirements.funding: PROHIBITED until C01-C12 machine conformance passes

remaining_hard_unknowns_before_funding: Exact x402 payTo/settlement-recipient binding under a hostile or mutated 402 response
Fail-closed behavior when budget/policy state cannot be read or validated
Observed inability of the wallet credential to mutate policy, export signer/session material, generic-sign, add funds, or direct-transfer when transfer permission is false
Observed immediate revocation and replay rejection
next_action: Attach an ELTEX-specific thin adapter to the existing candidate-agnostic C01-C12 zero-balance harness and execute only after a zero-balance grant can be created without exposing secrets. Do not fund. Any C01-C12 failure returns candidate to NOT_APPROVED.
